'''Verkoss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who worked as an enforcer for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Brinojja]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Verkoss unsuccessfully attempted to capture the [[Information broker/Legends|information merchant]] [[Rat (Human)|Rat]] for Brinojja on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

==Biography==
Verkoss was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as the chief enforcer of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]<ref name="Soulsaber" /> [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Light and Dark">"[[Light and Dark (adventure)|Light and Dark]]"</ref> [[Brinojja]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Soulsaber" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Child of Light]]'' is set four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], an event dated by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' to the sixth month of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. As the ''Atlas'' states that there are twelve months in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]], it can therefore be inferred that ''Child of Light'' takes place in the tenth month of 3 ABY. [[Soulsaber (adventure)|''Soulsaber'']] is set approximately four months after ''Child of Light'' and can thus be dated to the second month of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Brinojja sent Verkoss to apprehend the [[Information broker/Legends|information merchant]] [[Rat (Human)|Rat]] from a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Verkoss led ten of Brinojja's thugs into the bar and confronted Rat and several [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents with whom the information merchant was conducting business. An intense [[lightfight]] erupted between the two groups and Verkoss and his thugs perused Rat and the Rebels through the depths of Nar Shaddaa. Verkoss and his hoodlums eventually pinned their targets down in a dead-end alley. Determined to [[Death/Legends|take the lives]] of Rebels, Verkoss and his forces taunted the group while laying down heavy [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire against them. However, Rat and the Rebels, were airlifted to safety by the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Lazy Katarn]]'' and escaped from Verkoss.<ref name="Soulsaber" />

==Personality and traits==
Though strong-willed, Verkoss was careful not to needlessly sacrifice his troops when in combat. He was [[Language/Legends|multilingual]] and in addition to [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]] was fluent in the languages [[Dosh/Legends|Dosh]] and [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]].<ref name="Soulsaber" />

==Equipment==
During his attempt to apprehend Rat, Verkoss wore [[Padded armor/Legends|padded battle armor]] and wielded a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] and a [[Vibrodagger/Legends|vibrodagger]].<ref name="Soulsaber" />

==Behind the scenes==
Verkoss appeared in [[Soulsaber (adventure)|''Soulsaber'']], a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure by written by [[Lee Pickler]] and published by [[RPGA]] in [[2001]]. The adventure served as the second instalment of the [[Child of Light saga|''Child of Light'' saga]] and is set within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity. In ''Soulsaber'' the players roleplay as the Rebels that Verkoss combats on Nar Shaddaa and their fight can play out in a number of ways. If Verkoss' forces take losses against the Rebels, he urges his thugs to fall back and if events continue to turn against him, the Trandoshan orders his troops to shoot the street's [[Glow panel/Legends|glowpanels]], plunging the locality into darkness. It is also possible for the battle to result in Verkoss' incapacitation and death.<ref name="Soulsaber" />
